commit_message:
Implement enhanced AlbumEntity with Room annotations and validation

TDD Cycle #1: Create production-quality AlbumEntity
- Enhanced Room entity with id, title, artist, path, lastModified fields
- Performance indices for common query patterns (title+artist, path, lastModified)
- Built-in validation with isValid() method
- UI integration with getDisplayName() method
- Comprehensive test coverage for entity creation and validation
- Aligns with PLY-87 database architecture research

Features:
- Unique constraints prevent duplicate albums
- Column annotations for explicit database mapping
- KDoc documentation for all public APIs
- Ready for production use with UUID ID generation
